milestone.title: Dogfooding ergonomics — agent doc split, review discovery, CLI gap closure

intent.outcome: Agents dogfooding this repo get a thin root AGENTS.md, rich plan-dir AGENTS.md with flow recipes and self-discovery hooks, and mp CLI fixes for review/spec queues without jq or grep.

problem.description: While dogfooding (Jul 2026): agents used jq/rg on mp output to answer 'what needs review?' despite mp reviews pending + mp inbox + mp list --spec-status review existing. Root AGENTS.md duplicates master-plan/AGENTS.md (~270 lines vs ~220), bloating every code session. --fields projection fails on list milestones (id) and show milestone (review_state). Inbox has no kind filter for review-only views. No single command merges execution-review queue and spec-approval queue.

in_scope: Root AGENTS.md slimmed: repo purpose, dogfood pointer, plan vs code zone one-liner, dev commands table, link to master-plan/AGENTS.md + AGENT-READINESS

master-plan/AGENTS.md: canonical mp workflows (session start, plan, execute, review, remediate, track) as numbered flow recipes; discovery table pointing to --help, AGENT-READINESS, MP-COMMANDS, graph explain
mp reviews status (or extend mp status): pending_review_count + spec-review milestones + suggested next review action in one JSON blob
mp inbox --filter spec-review|execution-review|review (subset of actionable items)
Fix or document --fields paths for list milestones and computed review_state on show milestone --summary
Enrich mp reviews pending with optional --summary per item (steps done/total, open findings)
Track items or backlog entries for gaps deferred from this milestone during grooming
Integration tests for new/changed CLI surface
out_of_scope: raul TUI changes for review dashboard
Changing mp JSON default or removing jq entirely from agent workflows globally
Implementing every historical dogfood gap in one milestone — park overflow in track/backlog

acceptance_criteria.description: Root AGENTS.md is under ~80 lines and defers plan workflows to master-plan/AGENTS.md
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — line count + link check

acceptance_criteria.description: master-plan/AGENTS.md has session-start flow, plan-only flow, execute flow, review flow, and a discovery section (where to learn commands without duplicating MP-COMMANDS)
One mp read command returns both execution-review pending (M86-style) and spec-review milestones (M80-style) without shell filtering
mp inbox supports filtering to review-related items only (spec approval + execution review queue)
